verdict: Ascended Heroes has held its value better since release: AH26 81.01 (100 = Feb 2026) vs DR25 58.15 (100 = May 2025) at the Sep 28 mark (−19.0% in ~8 months vs −41.9% in ~16; DR25 at the same age, Jan 2026 recon, 63.07). Same side as the Sep 29 verdict, but no longer a near-tie: that read measured from Aug 24 (still −11.5% vs −12.3%, lead changed hands twice). Latest week −5.8% vs −8.4%. Top three sold-comp medians $2,167.40 vs $740.58. Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex SIR: DR #231 $412.25 (30 sales, Sep 19–Oct 1) vs AH #281 $250.00 (30 sales, Sep 18–29). Destined Rivals is the cheaper sealed entry: ETB $115.00 (25 live) vs $149.00 (14), bundle $54.99 (44) vs $74.99 (40); DR factory box $429.99 (4 live), no AH factory box listing (Oct 2).
